businesses.business: Electrical power distribution equipment and services

offering_description.value: Powell engineers and manufactures custom electrical distribution and control systems for industrial and energy customers. Its technicians maintain, upgrade, test and commission electrical equipment in the field and at service centers.

quotes.quote: Powell was as a metal-working shop to support the local Houston, Texas petrochemical facilities. While we began small, the company has grown to become the strategic supplier of choice for highly complex and integrated systems for the distribution and control of electrical energy and other critical processes.
Discover how Powell's skilled technicians provide electrical equipment services, switchgear maintenance, field service, and electrical commissioning.

primary_products.value: Integrated power distribution and control systems; circuit breakers; switchgear retrofit assemblies; spare and replacement parts
